# Command grammar. Usage errors exit 2, refusals exit 1, and neither
# writes to stdout.

! skycompat
! stdout .
stderr '\Ausage: skycompat import --shell PATH \[flags\] TASK\.yaml\|-\n\z'
env EXIT
stdout '^EXIT=2$'

skycompat help
stdout '\Ausage: skycompat import'
! stderr .

! skycompat launch task.yaml
! stdout .
stderr 'unknown command "launch"'
env EXIT
stdout '^EXIT=2$'

skycompat import -h
! stdout .
stderr 'shell path'
stderr 'workdir-ref file'
stderr 'allow-drop field'
stderr 'env KEY=VALUE'

! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh
! stdout .
stderr '\Ausage:'
env EXIT
stdout '^EXIT=2$'

! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh task.yaml other.yaml
! stdout .
env EXIT
stdout '^EXIT=2$'

! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --shell /bin/bash task.yaml
! stdout .
stderr 'repeated'

! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --unknown task.yaml
! stdout .
stderr 'flag provided but not defined: -unknown'

! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --timeout-seconds 10m task.yaml
! stdout .
stderr '\Askycompat: invalid --timeout-seconds\n\z'

# Environment values may be secrets and are never echoed.
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --env TOKEN=s3cr3t --env TOKEN=s3cr3t task.yaml
! stdout .
cmp stderr dup-env.txt
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --env s3cr3t task.yaml
cmp stderr bad-env.txt

# Invalid options are refusals.
! skycompat import --shell bin/sh task.yaml
! stdout .
cmp stderr shell.txt
env EXIT
stdout '^EXIT=1$'
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh/../sh task.yaml
cmp stderr shell.txt
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --timeout-seconds 604801 task.yaml
stderr '\Atasklower: timeout outside 0\.\.604800 seconds\n\z'
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --allow-drop run task.yaml
stderr '\Atasklower: allow-drop accepts only name and _user_specified_yaml\n\z'
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --output /abs workdir.yaml --workdir-ref ref.json
stderr '\Ausage:'
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref ref.json --output /abs workdir.yaml
stderr '\Atasklower: invalid output root\n\z'
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --output out task.yaml
stderr '\Atasklower: outputs require a task workdir\n\z'
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref ref.json task.yaml
stderr '\Atasklower: workdir reference supplied for a task without workdir\n\z'

# Input files.
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh missing.yaml
! stdout .
stderr '\Askycompat: open missing\.yaml: '
env EXIT
stdout '^EXIT=1$'
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref bad-ref.json workdir.yaml
! stdout .
cmp stderr bad-ref.txt
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref missing.json workdir.yaml
stderr '\Askycompat: open missing\.json: '

-- task.yaml --
run: echo hi
-- workdir.yaml --
workdir: .
run: echo hi
-- ref.json --
{"id":"00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff","sha256":"000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f","size":4096}
-- bad-ref.json --
{"id":"00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff","sha256":"000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f","size":"4096"}
-- bad-ref.txt --
skycompat: invalid workdir reference
-- dup-env.txt --
skycompat: duplicate --env key
-- bad-env.txt --
skycompat: --env requires KEY=VALUE
-- shell.txt --
tasklower: shell must be a clean absolute path
